title: 37% Joined. Then 86% Did. Only the Default Changed.
notes: Money tint #E3F1E7 solid + floor_strip; chip MONEY · THE DEFAULT.
Hero object: tall bar (scenes 1-3), then the sign-up form (4-5), then the SAVE RATE meter (7, 10).
Cite card scene-06 shows the result (37% > 86%) before study details; limit: one company, new hires. Source: NBER WP 7682 full text, QJE not read (idea.md).
NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE tag from scene-06 to the end. No loop or trailing scene: video ends 0.1 s after the voiceover.
Coral is used for the cross on the blank opt-in (scene-04), the catch (scene-07) and the draining wallet (scene-08) only; Mint always has a check or up-arrow.
Cuts inside a segment are estimated by letter count; inter-segment gaps belong to the preceding scene. page_turn (slide_up) used only into the cite card.
